summary: The response asserts that the Airport Spur is in conformance with national, regional, state, and local transportation goals, and that it will provide an opportunity for improved modified rapid bus transit as an alternative to continued automobile use.
text: 5. The Airport Spur is in conformance and will implement national, regional, state, and local transportation goals. The proposed freeway would accommodate longer trips and high speed traffic demands of auto, truck, and modified rapid transit vehicles and remove this portion of the total ground transportation demand from adjacent local streets. The proposed facility will also provide an opportunity for improved modified rapid bus transit to the area as an alternate to continued automobile use. Please see pages 80 and 81.
